{{Quote|Can I talk about why Artom's dumb now?|Grunt|<ref name="Manifesto My Foot">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20040318manifesto|text=Manifesto My Foot}}</ref>}}
'''Grunt''' was an alias that was used by a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] who served as a [[Private/Legends|private]] in the [[Cularin Militia]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Following the discovery of a document written by the [[Scout/Legends|explorer]] [[Reidi Artom]], Grunt and two Militia privates under the alias' [[Pac]] and [[Mack (alias)|Mack]] made their way to the offices of [[Cularin Central Broadcasting]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] and demanded to be interviewed by the [[Journalist/Legends|reporter]] [[Yara Grugara]]. Grugara agreed to their proposition and during the interview, Grunt and his compatriots explained that they were opposed to the anti-war viewpoint that Artom expressed in the recently discovered document. Grunt described Artom as "dumb" and Pac considered the Trandoshan's views to be extreme, but believed that Grunt's views were representative of some portions of the Cularin Militia.
